execution_details: Signal ATR and stop distance frozen at decision; entry stop uses cost-adjusted fill. Stops observed at completed closes execute strictly later, never intraday.
Both splits start cash and liquidate at final eligible close including costs. Five remaining sessions required for new entries, matching existing accounting convention.
Unfilled entries/resizes replaced at a later weekly snapshot; triggered exits cannot be cancelled. Same-close exits precede buys. No same-close re-entry of a stopping stock.
WATM has no maximum holding age; it remains weekly eligible or exits. WVB/WCR regime gates entry; their original explicit exit set is preserved.
WCR uses a new previous-week event and four strictly prior weekly decisions after exit. One decision cannot fill twice.
Whole-share India resizes below one permitted share are no-ops, recorded explicitly; original fee-inclusive ledger cash budget and rounding are retained.

Missing benchmark required indicators abort a prepared evaluation; missing stock entry inputs are ineligible; missing held closes fail; missing required exit inputs abort. No synthetic zero attention.

If desired buy budgets exceed available sale proceeds plus cash, fund buys proportionally within that budget. Preserve requested targets separately in events; record funded target weights in executable orders. This enforces the original subject-to-available-cash limit; no alpha threshold or ranking changes. Whole-share unfundable resize remains a recorded no-op.

WVB breakout removal disables breakout gate and sets ranking equal. Volume/wiki deletion disables only that gate. prior10 low deletion disables that exit.

WCR ratio deletion disables prior/current ratio conditions; z deletion disables prior z threshold. RSI/SMA20 removal disables that indicator in both entry and exit. Return1 removal disables positive-return gate and sets rankings equal.
ATR predictive deletion removes only the ranking denominator in WVB/WCR: rank raw excess/return1. Protective ATR sizing/stops remain fixed, as in the existing frozen ablation methodology.
Deletion variants retain baseline coverage requirements except the explicitly removed whole source filter. Stops/costs/execution/caps are never deleted.
